title: Distribution Transformer Pakistan 2026 — 11kV/415V Dry-Type vs Oil-Immersed Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete Pakistan 2026 buyer guide to distribution transformers: 11kV/415V dry-type vs oil-immersed comparison, WAPDA-approved specs, NTDC Grid Code requirements, KVA sizing table for Pakistani industrial loads, 2026 PKR price table (100–2000 kVA), SRD import duty with DTRE exemption, and 7 Pakistan-specific risks including loadshedding overloading, oil degradation in 45°C ambient, K-factor underspecification in VFD-heavy plants, cotton dust radiator blockage, and seismic bracing for KPK/Balochistan installations.
author: CNC Electric
